_comment: TM definitions (R4.4, GAME_DESIGN.md 13). A TM is found once in the world and picking it up permanently unlocks its move as teachable -- never consumed after that, so the same found TM can teach any number of compatible creatures. `move_id` must exist in data/moves/moves.json; `compatible_types` lists which data/creatures/species.json `type` values may learn it. Same-type only for this pass -- 13's 'off-type moves are allowed when physically/thematically sensible' is a real design call this data does not make on its own.
